options.autofish.title: Autofish Settings
options.autofish.basic.title: Basic Options
options.autofish.enable.title: Enable Autofish
options.autofish.enable.tooltip: Toggles the entire mod on or off.
options.autofish.multirod.title: Enable MultiRod
options.autofish.multirod.tooltip:
Cycles through all of the available rods
in the hotbar, moving to the next as
they break.
options.autofish.break_protection.title: Enable Break Protection
options.autofish.break_protection.toolti:
Stop using rods with low durability
before they break.
options.autofish.open_water_detection.to:
After 20w12a (1.16), you can only get
treasure loot in open water.
This will let you know when your hook
is not in open water.
options.autofish.persistent.title: Enable Persistent Mode
options.autofish.persistent.tooltip:
Enable this to always keep the fish hook
cast whenever a rod is in hand.
Checks every §610§f seconds and recasts if
needed. This is useful for lag issues or
when fishing for long periods of time.
options.autofish.advanced.title: Advanced Options
options.autofish.sound.title: Use Sound Detection
options.autofish.sound.tooltip:
§6Newer, more accurate detection based on
bobber sounds rather than the standard
hook movement detection.§r
§f- You must be somewhat close to the hook
  for this to work.
- If other players' hooks are close by,
it can falsely trigger a catch!
options.autofish.open_water_new_algorith:
§6New implementation more closely
following the documented open water
validation process.§r
§fTurn off to restore legacy behaviour.
options.autofish.noisy_detection.title: Keep Detection Notification
options.autofish.noisy_detection.tooltip:
Keep sending notification of detection
results to the player, regardless of
previous results. Affects the following:
- Open water detection
options.autofish.recast_delay.title: Recast Delay (ms)
